name: High School Love Adventure
source:
Memories of a lost childhood friend resurface when Nanasaki meets Miyamoto. Together, they explore friendship, romance, and choices that could lead to joy – or tragedy.

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/high-school-love-adventure/79270]Gamejolt[/url]]

当七崎遇见宫本时，对失去的儿时好友的记忆重新浮现。他们一起探索友谊、浪漫和可能带来欢乐或悲剧的选择。

[来自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/high-school-love-adventure/79270]Gamejolt[/url]]
